notes.title: Compatibility update published
notes.content:
We know how passionately you play our games and how many of you enjoy revisiting the beginnings of the X series every now and then. To keep it that way, we have just released small patches for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840/X_Beyond_the_Frontier/]X: Beyond the Frontier[/url] (1999) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850/X_Tension]X-Tension[/url] (2000), which now ensure the functionality of both games on Windows 10 and 11.

We wish you lots of fun with X: Beyond the Frontier and X-Tension! Feel free to check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/egosoft]Steam developer page[/url] to discover more games in the X series if you do not already know them.
